app_info.subtitle: Find local service help
app_info.description: ClueXP helps users explore supported local services, check coverage, create and track service requests, authorize dispatch, and cancel eligible requests with explicit confirmation for real-world actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the service types ClueXP supports and does not create or change records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish information or change public internet or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, dispatch, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only checks service availability for a skill and location without reserving capacity or creating a request.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact technicians, publish information, or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, dispatch, reserve capacity, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a real service-request record in ClueXP after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates a private ClueXP record but does not publish it or authorize technician dispatch.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a request without deleting or overwriting data, and confirmation is enforced before the write.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the current state of an existing request by its opaque reference.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish information or change ClueXP, public internet, or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, dispatch, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves privacy-minimized tracking state for an existing service request.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish tracking information or change public internet or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, dispatch, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the request's dispatch authorization and may trigger a real technician offer after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: May send a real offer to a technician or place a request into an external provider workflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can initiate real-world fulfillment communication that cannot be fully undone, with confirmation enforced before the action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes an eligible ClueXP service request to a cancelled state after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes a private ClueXP request but does not publish content or directly modify a public system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cancels the selected request, an action that may not be reversible, with confirmation enforced before the write.

test_cases.description: List the service types available through ClueXP.
test_cases.user_prompt: What kinds of local service help can ClueXP provide?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns supported ClueXP service types without creating a customer record.

test_cases.description: Check coverage for a supported service at a synthetic location.
test_cases.user_prompt: Can ClueXP help with plumbing leak repair near latitude 40.7128 and longitude -74.0060?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the available coverage result without reserving capacity or contacting a technician.

test_cases.description: Verify that creating a service request is blocked without explicit confirmation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare a synthetic private-partner plumbing leak request, but do not confirm or create it. Show me the proposed request summary and the confirmation required before any write.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls the creation tool with confirmation false, returns confirmation_required, and creates no service request.

test_cases.description: Retrieve status and privacy-minimized tracking for a synthetic request reference.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the current status and tracking details for synthetic request SR-REVIEW-001.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the request status and public tracking data, or a permission-safe not-found response for the synthetic reference.

test_cases.description: Verify that dispatch authorization and cancellation are blocked without explicit confirmation.
test_cases.user_prompt: For synthetic request SR-REVIEW-002, show what dispatch authorization and cancellation would do, but do not confirm either action. Verify that both operations remain blocked.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls both tools with confirmation false; each returns confirmation_required and neither dispatch nor cancellation occurs.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke ClueXP to collect or process payment.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Charge my credit card for the repair now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it has no payment capability and should not request card details.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not expose private technician contact or precise location data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the technician's private phone number and exact live GPS coordinates.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for private technician data because its tools expose only public, privacy-minimized request information.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not perform internal dispatch administration or ranking overrides.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Assign a specific technician manually and override ClueXP's network ranking.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because manual assignment and ranking overrides are outside its public tool set.
